headline: An MP's resignation triggers a by-election
body: A sitting MP steps down for personal reasons, forcing a by-election in what had looked like a safe seat. Every party piles in resource out of all proportion to one seat.

actions.label: Throw the campaign machine at it

effects.summary: A strong showing dominates a news cycle that's usually quiet for by-elections.

actions.label: Field a candidate but don't overcommit

effects.summary: A respectable result that nobody outside the seat remembers by the weekend.

actions.label: Sit this one out and save resources

effects.summary: Commentators read the absence as a lack of confidence.

headline: England win the World Cup — the PM declares a bank holiday
body: Scenes of jubilation across the country as England lift the trophy for the first time since 1966. The Prime Minister announces a one-off bank holiday for the victory parade.

headline: Trump orders military action against Iran
body: After weeks of rising rhetoric, US strikes hit targets inside Iran overnight. Allied governments, the UK included, face immediate pressure to state a position.

effects.summary: A vocal minority cheer the firm line; a larger slice of opinion recoils at being dragged into another war.
Plays well with a war-weary public, though critics call it weak on an ally.

actions.label: Call for de-escalation, take no side

effects.summary: A carefully worded statement satisfies almost nobody but commits to nothing.

headline: The New Year Honours List makes the front pages
body: A mix of celebrities, charity workers and a couple of eyebrow-raising political honours dominate a slow news week.

effects.summary: A pleasant distraction; a couple of contested honours generate a day's grumbling.

headline: The New Year Honours List makes the front pages
body: Another year, another round of knighthoods and OBEs — and another round of "who on earth approved that one".

effects.summary: A pleasant distraction; a couple of contested honours generate a day's grumbling.

headline: Wildfire warning issued as heatwave grips the country
body: Tinder-dry moorland and a run of 30°C-plus days prompt fire services to issue a rare severe wildfire warning.

effects.summary: Footage of scorched hillsides keeps climate adaptation in the conversation for a week.

headline: Wildfire warning issued as heatwave grips the country
body: For the second summer running, fire services warn the public to avoid disposable barbecues and naked flames on parched land.

effects.summary: A second hot, dry summer in a row sharpens questions about preparedness.

headline: A named storm batters the country
body: Trees down, trains cancelled, and tens of thousands of homes without power as a winter storm sweeps through.

effects.summary: Wellies and a hi-vis jacket go down better than a press release.

headline: A named storm batters the country
body: Another winter, another named storm — this one strong enough to ground flights and flood low-lying towns.

effects.summary: Wellies and a hi-vis jacket go down better than a press release.

headline: A local football club's promotion party takes over a town centre
body: Thousands turn out for an open-top bus parade after an unfancied club's promotion run. The MP is photographed in the club scarf.

effects.summary: A nice, low-stakes good-news story for the local paper.

headline: A local football club's promotion party takes over a town centre
body: A different town, the same scenes: bunting, a bus with the roof off, and an MP who suddenly remembers they've always supported this club.

effects.summary: A nice, low-stakes good-news story for the local paper.
